apps.versionDescription: Spotify Core v0.60.12 (Modified by Ares) — Built on Spotify 9.1.90: Reworked the 'Premium, ads & privacy' page to match the EeveeSpotifyReincarnated engine (Premium & True Shuffle controls, Hide upsells enabled and migrated ON by default, Clean shared links toggle, Block telemetry enabled by default, expanded 9.1.90 ad service blockers, and clean live counters).
apps.localizedDescription: Spotify Core (Modified by Ares) built on Spotify 9.1.90: 20 custom app icons in Appearance -> App icon (iOS 16.1+ & iOS 26+), curated first-install defaults, Liquid Glass UI (iOS 26+) & Legacy UI (iOS 16.1+), built-in Spotify Premium Lifetime & ad-blocking, True Shuffle, Clean shared links, synced lyrics & Sing mode, offline downloads, Audio DSP, AutoMix, Live Activity, and Open in Spotify Core Safari extension.
